name: L10-PanoLab true-heading entrance-ray projection
question: Can an OSM entrance node be projected into a Panoramax equirectangular image using only public camera pose, camera-native true heading, and official viewer coordinate semantics?
information_change: open a previously unavailable camera-to-OSM entrance ray; this is a new observation representation, not a matcher or threshold rescue

semantics: getXY adds the picture original heading to Photo Sphere Viewer yaw
setXYZ subtracts the picture original heading before viewer rotation
for a 360 image, the viewer applies sphere correction only when both pitch and roll are nonzero
texture x=0 is viewer yaw 180 degrees
texture x=full_width/2 is viewer yaw 0 degrees
spherical-to-texture conversion applies the inverse pose and sphere correction before equirectangular lookup

provenance_boundary: the API writes database heading to STAC view:azimuth
heading may come from GPSImgDirection, Mapillary TrueHeading, GPSTrack, a sequence-derived value, or a later API edit
therefore view:azimuth alone never opens projection; the owning-instance item must also expose a matching GPSImgDirection with true-north reference

applicability_gate.view_azimuth_meaning: clockwise degrees from true north for the image center
applicability_gate.rejection_rule: if any gate fails, the image has no authorized world-bearing-to-raw-pixel projection

projection.bearing: initial geodesic bearing from camera lon/lat to OSM entrance-node lon/lat, clockwise from true north
projection.rounding: retain floating-point degrees through selection; round only the final pixel coordinate

fresh_roster_rule.exclude_item_ids: all 42 item IDs in l10-panolab-stratified-source-v1 metadata-freeze
fresh_roster_rule.self_and_other_pair: same official sequence with reciprocal provider prev/next links
fresh_roster_rule.selection_order: scenario, target-way ID, descending ray separation for tenant and multi or descending displacement for occlusion strata, sequence ID, item ID
fresh_roster_rule.pixel_admission_after_freeze: a marker-blind reviewer must find the claimed portal or claimed occlusion transition inside the frozen projected crop; projection alone is not portal truth

diagnostic_calibration.source: four target intervals partially identified during the already-consumed v1 pixel audit
diagnostic_calibration.excluded_rows: TEN04, TEN05, TEN06, and MUL01 all lack camera-native EXIF true-heading provenance; TEN05 also missed its interval by more than 20 degrees
diagnostic_calibration.authority: diagnostic only; not a metric and not roster admission

claim_boundary.allowed: projected observation crop and active PAN target for an applicability-gated image
